editorial.name: Appointlet
editorial.descriptionZh: 在线预约排期工具，客户在品牌化页面上自助选时段，团队侧可以按人分派、排多人会议，并把邀请、提醒和视频会议室一起自动建好。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它怎么把预约页示例嵌进首屏主视觉
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底，最上面一行小字 Trusted by 100,000+ companies and organizations across the world，下面一排灰色客户 logo：Capterra、SoFi、Optimizely、ELEVATE、mendability、mixpanel。再往下是蓝色主标题 Your scheduling process will make an impression - make sure it's a good one.，副标题写 Disorganized booking frustrates clients and wastes valuable time.，中间一颗绿色 Get Started for Free 按钮。主视觉下方嵌了一张预约页示例：左边是 EDGE VENTURES 的品牌卡写着 Web Conference、30 minutes，右边是一列时段 9:00 am、10:00 am，绿色高亮当前选中项。往下正文写 Wow clients with professional appointment scheduling.，再拆成 Stay on brand with customization、Save time with automated invites, reminders, and rooms、Keep everyone on track with team scheduling 三块。
editorial.pricing: Free to try - 导航写 Start free，首屏写 Get Started for Free 与 No credit card required；档位在 /pricing

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Appointlet 这个排期产品的行业方案、集成清单与预约页示例，用户拿走的是落地页结构与文案，没有可下载的组件或素材。
站内路径是 /features、/teams、/integrations/*、/online-scheduling-for-* 这类自家产品与行业页，另有 /appointlet-vs-calendly 对比页，形态是产品官网。
